name: Seventh-generation desaturated bloom
summary: The first HD consoles push normal maps, bloom and HDR light, and art direction answers with grey, brown and teal: desaturated ruins, heavy contrast, glowing windows and wet, specular surfaces.

philosophy.core_thesis: Realism is grit: a serious world is grey, worn and wet, and light blooms out of the dark.
design_principles: Desaturate the palette to browns, greys and a teal or a sepia grade.
Use normal maps on every surface for cracks, bolts and grime.
Let bright areas bloom: windows and sky glow past their edges.
Make surfaces wet and specular, with sharp highlights.
Use high contrast: crushed shadows and blown highlights.
Fill spaces with debris, cover and ruins.

projection_and_camera.camera: Over the shoulder, low and close.
projection_and_camera.framing: Player at the left third; heavy cover in the foreground.

geometry.budget: 10,000–20,000 triangles for a character; dense debris.
geometry.edge_rule: Hard edges hidden by normal-map bevels; visible aliasing at 720p.
geometry.proportion: Realistic to bulky: wide shoulders and big armour.

surface.texture_rule: Normal, diffuse and specular maps with grime, cracks and wet patches.
surface.material_model: Blinn-Phong with normal and specular maps; strong rim light.

palette.strategy: Desaturated browns and greys with a teal or a sepia grade on the whole frame.

lighting.model: Per-pixel dynamic light with HDR tone mapping and bloom.
lighting.shadows: Sharp shadow maps with visible steps; screen-space ambient occlusion.
lighting.atmosphere: Bloom, dust, smoke, lens flare and god rays.
lighting.time_of_day: Overcast, dusk or a stormy grey day.

world_and_space.scale: Real scale with oversized cover objects.
world_and_space.interiors: Ruined rooms, warehouses and bunkers with debris and broken walls.
world_and_space.exteriors: Bombed streets, grey squares and wet alleys.
world_and_space.threshold: A door kicked open, or a continuous walk with no load.

principles.rule: Use 3 layers: grey ambient, a blooming window or sky key, and fire accents.
Lay out paths as lanes between cover objects.
Put debris in the foreground, the player in the middle, a bright opening behind.

interface.placement: Minimal, grey and translucent in the corners, about 5% of the screen.
interface.type_and_icons: Thin military sans fonts and simple line icons.
interface.diegesis: Some on the weapon or in the world; the rest on top.

emotion.target_response: Grim tension: the viewer feels weight, danger and a world worn down.

avoid_when: The brief needs warmth or a family tone.
The space must sell as bright and new.

modifiers.how: Keep the realism; replace bloom and grime with physical materials and balanced light.
Raise saturation and paint warm light into the surfaces.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Seventh generation of video game consoles
